$comment: Kurahi enterprise build profile (release 2.2). One entry per directory in extensions/; src/packaging/profiles/enterprise-profile.test.ts fails when an extension is missing. Read by scripts/bundle.mjs, scripts/npm-pack.mjs, scripts/pack-plugin.mjs, scripts/enterprise-check.mjs and, at runtime, src/plugins/profile-gate.ts. See docs/security/enterprise-profile.md.

tiers.enterprise: Shipped in the enterprise package and allowed to load under the enterprise profile.
tiers.optional: Not in the enterprise package. Shipped as a separate plugin archive (kurahi-<id>-<version>.tgz); loads under the enterprise profile only when the administrator installs it and enables it explicitly (plugins.entries.<id>.enabled: true, plugins.allow or the memory slot).
tiers.excluded: Not in the enterprise package and refused by the runtime under the enterprise profile, even when copied into a plugin directory and enabled.

a2a.reason: Agent2Agent protocol server and client tools: interoperability with enterprise agent platforms behind gateway auth and signed agent messaging.

alpha-vantage.reason: Free-tier consumer market-data feed (stocks, forex, crypto) used for personal briefings; not a business connector.

bluebubbles.reason: Consumer channel: iMessage through a relay on a personal Mac.

box.reason: Box business connector, read-only by default, fetches go through the attachment scanner into the Project.

brave-search.reason: Web search is business-relevant but sends queries to an external API with a separate key; opt-in after the customer reviews that data egress.

circadian.reason: Private-deployment origin: phase-of-day signal from a private deployment's agent persona layer; no business function.

copilot-proxy.reason: Proxies a personal GitHub Copilot subscription as a model provider; licence terms do not cover use inside a business product.

diagnostics-otel.reason: OpenTelemetry exporter to the customer's own collector; no data leaves except to the configured endpoint.

entra.reason: Microsoft Entra ID business connector: OIDC sign-in and directory read.

freee.reason: freee accounting business connector (Japan), bounded reads.

gmail.reason: Google Workspace mail business connector, read-only by default.

google-gemini-cli-auth.reason: Reuses a consumer CLI OAuth login as a model credential; enterprise deployments configure contracted API keys in the core providers.

googlechat.reason: Google Workspace chat channel: business-grade, but outside the channel set reviewed for 2.2; separate archive, explicit opt-in.

health-watchdog.reason: Gateway liveness watchdog (lease and listener checks, audited supervisor restart); local operations only, on by default.

ibm-data.reason: Read-only IBM watsonx.data (SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE only, catalog allowlist, row and byte limits) and allow-listed Db2 REST services; off by default.

imessage.reason: Consumer channel: personal Apple ID on macOS.

kintone.reason: kintone business connector: configured apps, bounded record queries with a field allow-list.

legacy-analyzer.reason: Legacy analyser tools (COBOL, copybooks, JCL) for modernisation projects; local analysis only.

libretranslate.reason: Translation is business-relevant; the default public instance would receive document text, so it is opt-in and should point at a self-hosted server.

line.reason: Consumer channel: LINE Messaging API for personal accounts. The business path is line-works.

line-works.reason: LINE WORKS business connector: bot channel information and members, read-only by default.

llm-task.reason: JSON-only LLM task tool on the configured model; no data path beyond the configured provider.

lobster.reason: Runs an external workflow CLI that is neither shipped nor reviewed with the product; inherited upstream tooling.

locationiq.reason: Free-tier consumer geocoding API used for personal assistants; not a business connector.

log-rotation.reason: Size and age caps for state-root logs: local retention control.

matrix.reason: Self-hostable federated chat used in some public-sector deployments; native crypto addon and federation need their own review; separate archive, explicit opt-in.

mattermost.reason: Self-hosted team chat; business-grade but outside the channel set reviewed for 2.2; separate archive, explicit opt-in.

memory-boot-inject.reason: Private-deployment origin: injects a private deployment's continuity files into every agent bootstrap; no business function.

memory-core.reason: Core memory search (the default memory slot); local index.

memory-lancedb.reason: Needs the @lancedb native runtime (about 250 MB); separate archive, selected explicitly through plugins.slots.memory.

microsoft-365.reason: Microsoft 365 business connector: mail, calendar and files, read-only by default.

minimax-portal-auth.reason: Consumer portal OAuth login used as a model credential; enterprise deployments use contracted API keys.

money-forward.reason: Money Forward Cloud invoicing business connector (Japan), read-only.

msteams.reason: Microsoft Teams through an Azure bot in the customer's Entra tenant; direct messages default to pairing (owner approval) and group chats to an allow-list, so no conversation reaches an agent without an approval.

newsdata.reason: Free-tier consumer news feed used for personal briefings.

nextcloud-talk.reason: Self-hosted chat; business-grade but outside the channel set reviewed for 2.2; separate archive, explicit opt-in.

nostr.reason: Consumer channel: public social relay network.

ocr-space.reason: OCR is business-relevant (scanned invoices, forms), but this plugin uploads document content to the OCR.space cloud on a free tier; opt-in after the customer's data-processing review.

office.reason: Office document tools (PPTX, DOCX, XLSX) that write into the current Project folder; local only.

open-meteo.reason: Consumer weather feed used for personal briefings.

open-prose.reason: Third-party skill-pack VM with its own telemetry; not reviewed for the business product.

opencorporates.reason: Company-registry lookup is business-relevant but calls an external API with a separate licence; opt-in.

proactive-triggers.reason: Private-deployment origin: impulse rules that make agents start conversations unprompted; not wanted in a business product.

qwen-portal-auth.reason: Consumer portal OAuth login used as a model credential; enterprise deployments use contracted API keys.

scholar-sources.reason: Read-only literature sources (arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, PubMed) for Kurahi Scholars; public research metadata.

self-check.reason: Local security self-check (permissions, config, integrity, ports); supports the customer's own review.

signal.reason: Consumer channel: messenger tied to a personal phone number.

slack.reason: Slack workspaces and Enterprise Grid through a customer-installed app; direct messages default to pairing (owner approval) and channels to an allow-list, so no conversation reaches an agent without an approval.

smarthr.reason: SmartHR business connector: employees (work fields only) and departments, read-only.

voice-call.reason: Places and receives phone calls through a telephony provider; needs a telephony and call-recording review; separate archive, explicit opt-in.

watsonx-orchestrate.reason: IBM watsonx Orchestrate agent client: allow-listed agents, IAM auth, replies wrapped as untrusted, never an autopilot gather tool; off by default.

whatsapp.reason: Already a separately installed plugin since 2.1.0: its libsignal dependency is GPL-3.0 and may not ship in the package.

wolfram-alpha.reason: Consumer computation and knowledge API used for personal assistants.

zalouser.reason: Consumer channel: drives a personal Zalo account through an unofficial CLI.
